{{External|rs|rsc=Phoenix Crossbow}} {{Infobox Item |name = Phoenix crossbow |image = [[File:Phoenix crossbow.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = [[Shield of Arrav]] |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Inspect, Drop |examine = Former property of the Phoenix Gang. |value = 10 |weight = 3.628 |respawn = 100 |id = 767 }} [[File:Phoenix crossbow detail.png|left|130px]] The '''Phoenix crossbow''' is a [[quest item]], although it can be traded. It has the same stats as a regular [[crossbow]] except for attack range, but weighs significantly less. It can be obtained and is used in the quest [[Shield of Arrav]]. The Phoenix crossbow has no requirements to wield, and can only fire [[bronze bolts]]. It can also be used with a [[mith grapple]] for Agility shortcuts. The Phoenix crossbow is not often used, as the [[bronze crossbow]] requires the same [[Ranged]] level to equip, but gives a Ranged accuracy of +18, whilst the Phoenix crossbow only gives +6. However, the Phoenix crossbow is essentially free, and since bronze crossbows and above are [[members-only]] items, the Phoenix crossbow is the second-best crossbow available to [[free-to-play]] players. While the Phoenix crossbow is lighter than and has the same +6 range bonus as the standard [[crossbow]], the Phoenix crossbow has a maximum range of 7 tiles, whereas the standard crossbow has a range of 10 tiles. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = +6 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = weapon |speed = 6 |attackrange = 5 |combatstyle = Crossbow |image = [[File:Phoenix crossbow equipped.png|180px]] |altimage = [[File:Phoenix crossbow equipped female.png|180px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Crossbow|speed=6|attackrange=5}} ==Item sources== ===Item spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Phoenix crossbow|location=[[Varrock]] -
